parole.significato: punch, an alcoholic beverage, generally containing a mixture of fruit juice and some other beverages
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish پونچ (punç), from English punch, ultimately from Hindi पाँच (pā̃c, “five”), because of the drink's original five ingredients (spirits, water, lemon juice, sugar, and spice).
Borrowed from English cheetah, from Hindi चीता (cītā, “leopard, panther”), ultimately from Sanskrit चित्र (citra, “multicolored, speckled”) + काय (kāya, “body”), thus "having a spotted body".
